title: Score Sheet - Verbal Communication & Medical Management
scoring_notes: Each item is scored 0 (not demonstrated) up to its listed point value (fully demonstrated). Category subtotal is the sum of its items. Overall score is the sum of all category subtotals.

items.description: Introduces themselves and role appropriately
Demonstrates awareness of patient/caller and relevant situation already provided
Explains purpose of medical questions and advises that line is recorded where required
Adapts introduction to urgency of situation
Opens appropriately and allows the caller to explain the situation before focused probing
Establishes onset, duration and progression of the problem
Obtains relevant presenting symptoms/signs, severity and functional impact
Specifically identifies and explores relevant clinical red flags
Obtains relevant Past Medical History, regular medication, allergies and other clinical background where relevant
Establishes healthcare already sought, assessment/investigations/treatment and response where relevant
Asks about current location, travel plans/history, support/accompanying persons and access to care
Escalates situation according to applicable procedures where relevant

categories.category_name: RFA, Medical Advice, Disposition & Safety Netting

items.description: Provides an appropriate level/type of care or disposition and explains the rationale
Gives an appropriate timeframe for obtaining care
Provides safe immediate advice, first aid or self-management where relevant
Explains relevant expected course / what to expect at the provider / next stage of care
Gives relevant deterioration signs and specific actions to take if they occur
Identifies and demonstrates understanding of the initial RFA
Recognises when the patient's need differs from initial RFA
Confirms the agreed RFA / case direction after Medical Team's assessment
Summarise the assessment and agreed plan
Agreed a time to call back for next update
Confirm whether caller has further medical questions
Remind caller that assistance is available 24/7, and to call back anytime for assistance
Warm transfer back to Operations Specialist
Avoid giving payment advice or make coverage commitments
Demonstrate confidence, empathy and reassurance appropriate to the situation
Speaks clearly and is easy to understand
